en: Rainwater, the rain knows its time.
ja: 雨水は、その時期を知っています。
local: Rainwater, the rain knows its time.
native: Rainwater, the rain knows its time.

en: After start of spring, rainwater comes around February 19th.
zh: 春天開始後，雨水大約在二月十九日來臨。
ja: 春の始まりの後、雨水は2月19日頃に訪れます。
local: After start of spring, rainwater comes around February 19th.
native: After start of spring, rainwater comes around February 19th.

en: Snow turns to rain, and the rain gently wets the earth.
zh: 雪變成雨，雨輕輕地滋潤大地。
ja: 雪が雨に変わり、雨は優しく大地を濡らします。
local: Snow turns to rain, and the rain gently wets the earth.
native: Snow turns to rain, and the rain gently wets the earth.

en: Farmers are happy, the rain helps their crops grow.
zh: 農夫很高興，雨水幫助作物生長。
ja: 農家は喜び、雨は作物の成長を助けます。
local: Farmers are happy, the rain helps their crops grow.
native: Farmers are happy, the rain helps their crops grow.

en: As the poet do through road, good rain knows the right season.
zh: 正如詩人走過道路，良好的雨水知道正確的季節。
ja: 詩人が道を歩くように、良い雨は適切な季節を知っています。
local: As the poet do through road, good rain knows the right season.
native: As the poet do through road, good rain knows the right season.

en: It sneaks in with the night wind, quietly nourishing everything.
zh: 它隨著夜風悄悄地進入，靜靜地滋養萬物。
ja: それは夜風と共に忍び込み、静かにすべてを養います。
local: It sneaks in with the night wind, quietly nourishing everything.
native: It sneaks in with the night wind, quietly nourishing everything.

en: Rivers start to flow again after being frozen.
zh: 河流在結冰後開始再次流動。
ja: 川は凍った後、再び流れ始めます。
local: Rivers start to flow again after being frozen.
native: Rivers start to flow again after being frozen.

en: In some places, people return to their parents' home with gifts.
zh: 在某些地方，人們帶著禮物回到父母家。
ja: ある場所では、人々が贈り物を持って実家に帰ります。
local: In some places, people return to their parents' home with gifts.
native: In some places, people return to their parents' home with gifts.

en: Rainwater reminds us gentle things can be the most powerful.
zh: 雨水提醒我們，溫柔的事物可能是最強大的。
ja: 雨水は、優しいものが最も強力であることを思い出させてくれます。
local: Rainwater reminds us gentle things can be the most powerful.
native: Rainwater reminds us gentle things can be the most powerful.
